name: Solved Central Alberta 2019

venue.name: [Parkland Mall](http://www.parklandmall.ca)
venue.details: Use Entrance #5 to mall, competition held in mall corridor between GoodLife Fitness and Ardene

information:
Welcome to **SOLVED CENTRAL ALBERTA 2019**!!

The Red Deer Speedcubing Club is excited to host the 1st ever WCA competition in Central Alberta! With help from Alberta Cubers, we hope to have a great day of fun competition and help grow speedcubing in this area. 

There is a food court on site with many options for lunch and snacks. Parking at the mall is free. 

Whether you are a veteran cuber or just starting out, we hope to see you September 28 in Red Deer!
